616:t_1:3.en: ～$$ラース・バビロン$$　Imperial Palace～

616:t_1:5.en:
$$執務官$$
「...The $$セントラル・ベース$$ on the Central Asian front has fallen to $c's attack.」

616:t_1:6.en:
$$執務官$$
「Earth's major counteroffensive, which began at almost the same time, has also taken 18 $$ターミナル・ベース$$s and three $$セントラル・ベース$$s.」

616:t_1:7.en:
$$執務官$$
「As a result, the $$新地球皇国$$'s control has declined to 52.6%.」

616:t_1:8.en:
$$執務官$$
「This is a drawback of the strategy of control through points and lines, as I have pointed out before.」

616:t_1:10.en:
$$執務官$$
「N-no... I did not mean to criticize Your Majesty...」

616:t_1:11.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「As long as $$ラース・バビロン$$ does not fall... No, as long as I am here, we can turn the situation around.」

616:t_1:12.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「And when you get down to it, Earth's strategy is even more thoroughly concentrated at a single point than ours.」

616:t_1:14.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Crush them, and our task is done. You could say that's why I came to this planet.」

616:t_1:15.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「I've given $$エルーナルーナ$$, $$尸空#pilot$$, and $$バルビエル$$ their orders. All that remains is to welcome them.」

616:t_1:19.en:
$$シオニー$$
「...Do you intend to win $c over?」

616:t_1:20.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「That's what I ordered $$エルーナルーナ$$ to do.」

616:t_1:21.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Though I would be disappointed if they obeyed my words.」

616:t_1:23.en:
$$シオニー$$
「Even though you know it is meaningless...」

616:t_1:24.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「You have quite a mouth for a mere $$メッセンジャー$$.」

616:t_1:25.en:
$$シオニー$$
「The one who brought me from $$陰月$$ to Earth... I now believe this is what he wanted to tell you.」

616:t_1:27.en:
$$シオニー$$
「I once fought for what I wanted to protect... No, I thought I was fighting for it.」

616:t_1:28.en:
$$シオニー$$
「Though I knew it was self-righteous reliance on power, I ended up drowning in that power.」

616:t_1:29.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Are you saying you're different now?」

616:t_1:30.en:
$$シオニー$$
「My beloved $$リモネシア$$ is regaining its beautiful sea and sky.」

616:t_1:31.en:
$$シオニー$$
「For $$リモネシア$$... and the people who live there, I have nothing to fear.」

616:t_1:33.en:
$$シオニー$$
「...Your Majesty $$アウストラリス$$... Please reconsider.」

616:t_1:37.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Don't think words can stop my fight.」

616:t_1:38.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「I'll teach you, too. What the world... what the galaxy needs now is overwhelming power.」

616:t_1:43.en:
$$トライア$$
「...We can't take $$ラース・バビロン$$ without facing the $$リアクター|lc$$s.」

616:t_1:46.en:
$$トライア$$
「I've gathered everyone involved with the $$スフィア$$s to organize our information.」

616:t_1:47.en:
$$トライア$$
「To sum things up, the 12 $$スフィア$$s are split four each between $c, $$サイデリアル$$, and $$アサキム$$.」

616:t_1:49.en:
$$ランド$$
「In the decisive battle at $$ラース・バビロン$$, $$皇帝アウストラリス$$ will probably join the usual trio.」

616:t_1:50.en:
$n
「The $$立ち上がる射手$$, $$皇帝アウストラリス$$...」

616:t_1:51.en:
$$セツコ$$
「But with $$ソーラリアン$$ on our side, they won't be able to use the same tactics as in the last battle at $$セントラル・ベース$$.」

616:t_1:52.en:
$$メール$$
「So it's a head-on clash! It's just your kind of fight, Darling.」

616:t_1:53.en:
$$ランド$$
「Well, at this point, $$エルーナルーナ$$ and $$バルビエル$$ probably won't bother with clumsy tricks.」

616:t_1:54.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Also, from what I heard in the Empire, $$サイデリアル$$'s $$リアクター|lc$$s can't take other people's $$スフィア$$s.」

616:t_1:55.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Since their main objective is to make us submit, they're bound to be a step behind us in terms of resolve.」

616:t_1:56.en:
$n
「$$バルビエル$$ would be an exception, though.」

616:t_1:58.en:
$$トライア$$
「I don't know whether it's some sort of pact or a functional restriction, but the main purpose is probably to prevent infighting.」

616:t_1:59.en:
$$トライア$$
「You can't cooperate when the person beside you is planning to stab you in your sleep.」

616:t_1:61.en:
$$クロウ$$
「In the case I know of, $$ユーサー$$ of the $$尽きぬ水瓶$$ absorbed the $$スフィア$$ of $$アイム#pilot$$ of the $$偽りの黒羊$$...」

616:t_1:62.en:
$$クロウ$$
「He apparently hadn't mastered the second $$スフィア$$, but even so, his power grew to a level rivaling $$ガイオウ$$'s.」

616:t_1:63.en:
$$メール$$
「Then does that make $$アサキム$$, with his four $$スフィア$$s, the strongest?!」

616:t_1:64.en:
$$トライア$$
「...I'm not sure... He's something different from a $$リアクター|lc$$.」

616:t_1:65.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$アサキム$$ used $$スフィア$$s too, but rather than becoming one with them like us, he seemed to force their power out.」

616:t_1:66.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Even so, he's still a formidable enemy.」

616:t_1:67.en:
$$ランド$$
「Yeah. If we can, I'd like to deal with the Empire's $$リアクター|lc$$s' $$スフィア$$s before he comes back.」

616:t_1:68.en:
$n
「Do you mean we should take their $$スフィア$$s ourselves?」

616:t_1:69.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...Depending on the situation, that would probably be the quickest way.」

616:t_1:70.en:
$$ランド$$
「But there's the question of compatibility, too.」

616:t_1:71.en:
$$ランド$$
「Isn't $$セツコ$$ against $$バルビエル$$ about the only pairing that could land a certain finishing blow?」

616:t_1:74.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I'm all right, $n. I have no hesitation.」

616:t_1:75.en:
$$セツコ$$
「It's just that his very existence makes me sad...」

616:t_1:76.en:
$n
「...If only we had enough power, we could settle things regardless of $$スフィア$$ compatibility...」

616:t_1:77.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That's just theory. I can't even imagine power great enough to beat a $$スフィア$$ at the so-called Third Stage regardless of compatibility.」

616:t_1:78.en:
$$ランド$$
「Only machines designed to take $$スフィア$$s in the first place could do it, like $$アサキム$$'s $$シュロウガ$$ or $n's $$ジェニオン$$.」

616:t_1:79.en:
$$スズネ$$
「So in the end, we have no decisive tactic against the $$リアクター|lc$$s...」

616:t_1:80.en:
$$トライア$$
「We'll have to adapt as we go. We could always catch them and throw them into $$ＺＯＮＥ$$, too.」

616:t_1:81.en:
$$トライア$$
「First, we crush the Empire... That's what we should put all our effort into.」

616:t_1:82.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Yeah. This is a war between Earth and the Empire, not just a fight between $$リアクター|lc$$s.」

616:t_1:83.en:
$$ランド$$
「Damn right. We'll do it for everyone fighting all over the world, too!」

616:t_1:84.en:
$$セツコ$$
「And we'll rescue the people being held captive, without fail.」

616:t_1:85.en:
$n
「$$新地球皇国$$... We're settling this in this battle...」
